rows.name: settings
rows.question: Please retrieve the official TEKKEN 8 rulebook evidence for in-game settings.

result.answer:
Characters and settings
* Any character may be selected except DLC characters.
* Character customization is prohibited in all cases, including outfits, hairstyles, fighting effects and auras.
* Only default skins may be used.
* Assist buttons or special assistance systems are allowed.
* Bugs or glitches that provide an advantage are prohibited.
* Once a game starts, pausing for any reason is prohibited.
* Deliberately pausing immediately results in a loss of 1 round. [S1]
Game Settings
* Number of rounds per game (Round): 3
* Time per round (Timer): 60 seconds
* Advantage: No advantage
* Stage: Random [S2]

result.answer:
A confirmed English translation is unavailable for some clauses; their Thai source text is retained below.
**PSU Phuket CS2 2026 Tournament**
1. Players may customize brightness, resolution, and crosshair settings only within the game and computer screen exclusively. [S1]
ผู้เล่นสามารถปรับแต่งความสว่าง (Brightness), ความละเอียดหน้าจอ (Resolution) และเป้าเล็ง (Crosshair) เฉพาะในเกม และหน้าจอคอมพิวเตอร์เท่านั้น [S2]
3. Strictly prohibited to use scripts or macros. [S3]
